description: Daily water and wastewater observations cover Pampagrande, Peru, from 17 August to 18 December 2025. The authors retain all 124 calendar days and analyse 114 dry-weather days, using five-minute water metering and hourly wastewater estimates. This resource is provided by Weckerle, Philip; Valdivia Chacón, Pablo Adolfo Humberto. Coverage is site as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. The provider lists CSV, MD, XLSX formats or archive containers, accessible through the linked landing page. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: The provider calls this preliminary. Nine rainfall days and one operational day are excluded from analysis but documented. For simulation, it can supply inputs or comparison evidence.
